### Checklist
1. [ ] A title in the commit format, `type(scope): Summary` (*eg. "feat(kgui): Left/right move the active category"*)
2. [ ] Related links below (*eg. the issue this PR closes*)
3. [ ] The documentation at docs.kode.diy updated if the change touches what it says
4. [ ] `tools/host_tests.sh`, `tools/check_layers.sh` and `tools/tool_tests.sh` run, and green
5. [ ] A change to the glass verified on a board: a screenshot of every screen it touches, and a look through `tools/kmirror.py`

*This entire section above can be deleted if all items are checked.*
